diagnostics.message:
[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run1]
aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource delivers to s3_bucket aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, but no dependency (attribute or depends_on) links it to aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy, which grants bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com permission to write (s3:PutObject, s3:GetBucketPolicy, with aws:SourceArn conditions). AWS validates destination bucket access at export-creation time; if the export is created before the policy is attached, the apply can fail with an AccessDenied/validation error — or, per the upstream provider bug noted in the code comments, the export gets created in AWS while the apply fails, requiring a manual import. Add depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy] (no attribute on the export can reference the policy, so a bare depends_on is the idiomatic fix here).

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run2]
aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource writes to aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report but has no dependency on aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy. BCM Data Exports validates at creation time that the destination bucket policy allows bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com to write; if the export is created before the bucket policy is applied, CreateExport fails. No attribute of the export can reference the policy, so an explicit depends_on is required.

----------------------------------------

[final-glm-5.3-flash-effort-high-run3]
aws_bcmdataexports_export.cur_per_resource writes to aws_s3_bucket.aws_billing_report, but BCM Data Exports validates that the destination bucket policy grants access to bcm-data-exports.amazonaws.com at export-creation time. The bucket policy (aws_s3_bucket_policy.cur_bucket_policy) must exist before the export is created; no attribute reference or depends_on currently expresses this ordering, so a first apply can fail with Access Denied.
